meta.accounting_basis: US GAAP with analyst-derived SBC-adjusted operating cash flow

source_basis.label: derived
source_basis.notes: Revenue, non-GAAP operating income, SBC, D&A, capex, cash flow, deferred revenue, and other working-capital inputs are from the filing. Owner FCFF treats SBC as an economic expense. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1373715/000137371526000007/now-20251231.htm

source_basis.label: analyst_estimate
source_basis.source_name: Analyst operating cases anchored to ServiceNow Q2 2026 results, FY2026 guidance, and 2030 targets
source_basis.notes: No consensus estimates are used. Revenue growth is anchored to Q2 cRPO growth, FY2026 subscription guidance, and the company's $30bn+ 2030 subscription revenue target. Margin cases deduct SBC as an economic cost. https://investor.servicenow.com/news/news-details/2026/ServiceNow-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx

source_basis.label: derived
source_basis.source_name: 10-year Treasury, observed beta, and analyst ERP/company-risk assumptions
source_basis.notes: Risk-free rate is the 10-year Treasury yield; beta is a current public market-data observation. ERP and company-specific premium are analyst assumptions. https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView?field_tdr_date_value=2026&type=daily_treasury_yield_curve ; https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/now/

source_basis.label: analyst_estimate
source_basis.notes: Perpetual growth is scenario-based and remains below the scenario discount rate. The sensitivity grid shows the concentration of value in terminal assumptions.

source_basis.label: reported
source_basis.source_name: ServiceNow Q2 2026 earnings release balance sheet
source_basis.notes: Cash plus current and long-term marketable securities is $6,707mm; short- and long-term debt is $7,517mm. Strategic investments are excluded from the bridge. https://investor.servicenow.com/news/news-details/2026/ServiceNow-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx

source_basis.label: reported
source_basis.notes: Q2 2026 diluted weighted-average shares were 1,034mm after the five-for-one split. https://investor.servicenow.com/news/news-details/2026/ServiceNow-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/default.aspx

source_basis.label: web_research
source_basis.notes: Observed share price was $97.35 at 10:12 a.m. EDT on July 23, 2026. This short-lived market-data input is used only for comparison and the reverse DCF. https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/now/

forecast.notes: Owner FCFF model. EBIT begins with non-GAAP operating income less SBC as an economic expense. Negative NWC captures the subscription/deferred-revenue funding model. D&A, capex, and NWC are explicit.

base.description: Q2 momentum persists and the company approaches its 2030 revenue target while SBC-adjusted operating margin expands through scale and lower SBC intensity.

downside.description: AI-related seat and pricing pressure slows growth, integration spending limits margin expansion, and deferred-revenue funding weakens.

upside.description: AI Control Tower and cross-sell accelerate durable growth, SBC intensity falls faster than targeted, and the platform compounds with stronger operating leverage.
